notes: These are old-joint-reader versus optimized-joint-reader observations on the same complete HAP indexes, not a new native/v3 comparison or a human-genome speed measurement.
All four rounds are retained, including the self round where the candidate was slower. The per-reader median ratio is primary; the paired-round median ratio is a descriptive sensitivity check.
Four single-host paired rounds with uncontrolled OS cache are descriptive observations, without a statistical significance or universal speedup claim.

Setup/seeding includes index setup and seed generation; it is not an isolated decoder timer. Native TimeTo CPU counters use parent-process rusage; output-converter child CPU is not included. Wall time includes waiting for output conversion.
Per-phase medians are computed separately and need not sum to the median total time. Peak RSS is normalized wait4 output in bytes.
Separate sampled CPU runs are excluded from all timing medians. Raw experimental reports are retained locally; private paths are omitted from this export.
